extra_nodes.name: AI engineering
extra_nodes.description: Turn AI from an idea on the roadmap into a feature your users rely on every day. We build assistants, agents and automation on foundation models, and we run them where your data is allowed to be: on-prem or in a sovereign cloud. Every system is grounded in your sources, tested against known answers and monitored after launch.

extra_nodes.name: Cloud platforms
extra_nodes.description: Give your engineers a platform they can count on as your team and your users grow, with pipelines that stay fast and costs that follow use. We build and run cloud platforms on GCP, AWS and on-prem. Together with Volvo Cars, we cut a build pipeline from 47 minutes to 6.

extra_nodes.name: Application development
extra_nodes.description: Launch products your users come back to. We build applications for mobile, web, desktop and embedded devices, and connect them to the systems behind them. Our work runs in production at scale, from consumer apps to a media application across a whole fleet.
